def: Generating text by drawing each token from the model's full next-token distribution and appending it.
Always choosing the single most probable next token, which is deterministic but tends to repeat itself in open-ended text.
A number that divides the logits before the softmax: below one it sharpens the distribution and above one it flattens it.
Sampling only from the k most probable tokens after renormalising.
Also called nucleus sampling: sampling only from the smallest set of tokens whose probabilities sum to at least p.
Sampling only from tokens whose probability is at least a set fraction of the most probable token's, so the cut-off scales with the model's confidence.
A search that keeps the several best partial sequences at each step and extends them all, to find a high-probability whole sequence.
Dividing a sequence's log-probability by a power of its length so that beam search does not prefer short outputs.
A degenerate output where the model repeats the same phrase indefinitely because repeated text makes more repetition likely.
A decoding adjustment that lowers the logits of tokens already generated, to reduce loops.
Setting the logits of tokens that would break a required format to minus infinity at each step, so the output is valid by construction.
Removing the unlikely tail of the next-token distribution before drawing, using top-k, top-p or min-p.
